lines.en: Ravi, my cousin from Brazil visited me last winter. He said he had never seen snow before.
lines.pt: Ravi, meu primo do Brasil me visitou no inverno passado. Ele disse que nunca tinha visto neve.

lines.en: Really? What did he say when it started to fall in Cardiff?
lines.pt: Sério? O que ele disse quando começou a cair neve em Cardiff?

lines.en: He told me he had always dreamed of it, but he hadn’t expected it to be so cold.
lines.pt: Ele me disse que sempre tinha sonhado com isso, mas não esperava que fosse tão frio.

lines.en: Did he say he had brought a proper coat? I bet he hadn’t.
lines.pt: Ele disse que tinha trazido um casaco adequado? Aposto que não.

lines.en: He admitted that he had only packed a light jacket, so I lent him my scarf.
lines.pt: Ele admitiu que só tinha levado uma jaqueta leve, então emprestei meu cachecol.

lines.en: Typical! My sister once told me that she had never worn gloves until she moved to Wales.
lines.pt: Típico! Minha irmã me contou uma vez que nunca tinha usado luvas até se mudar para o País de Gales.

lines.en: Anyway, he asked me whether I had ever built a snowman, and I said that I had, many times.
lines.pt: Enfim, ele me perguntou se eu já tinha feito um boneco de neve, e eu disse que sim, muitas vezes.

lines.en: And did he say whether he had ever touched snow before that morning?
lines.pt: E ele disse se já tinha tocado na neve antes daquela manhã?

lines.en: He said he hadn’t, so he took off his glove and laughed when it melted in his hand.
lines.pt: Ele disse que não, então tirou a luva e riu quando ela derreteu na mão dele.

lines.en: What a great story! Did he mention that he had taken any photos for his family?
lines.pt: Que história ótima! Ele mencionou que tinha tirado fotos para a família?

lines.en: Yes, he told me he had sent more than fifty photos to his mother before breakfast.
lines.pt: Sim, ele me disse que tinha mandado mais de cinquenta fotos para a mãe antes do café da manhã.

facts.label: Past perfect no discurso indireto
facts.sub: Disse que tinha: said he had + particípio. Me contou que tinha: told me he had. Perguntou se tinha: asked whether I had.

facts.label: Disse que tinha
facts.sub: No discurso indireto, a frase “I have never seen snow” vira He said he had never seen snow. O tempo recua um passo: present perfect vira had + particípio. Em português, “disse que nunca tinha visto”.

facts.label: Me disse
facts.sub: Depois de told, use sempre um objeto: He told me that he had packed a jacket. Nunca diga He told that. Said não leva objeto: He said that he had packed a jacket. O that é opcional na fala.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “I have never seen snow” becomes “He said he had never seen snow.”
In reported speech, we keep the present perfect after said.
items.why: We usually change it to had + participle.

items.s: “He told me he had packed a jacket” reports an earlier action.

answers: “I have never seen snow” becomes “He said he had never seen snow.” → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
In reported speech, we keep the present perfect after said. → Falso (We usually change it to had + participle.)
“He told me he had packed a jacket” reports an earlier action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A snowy morning in Cardiff · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a freezing morning in Cardiff, and the first snow of the year is falling. Walt and Tom stand outside a small café near the castle. Children throw soft snowballs across the pavement. Walt watches the white streets and smiles. This weather reminds him of his cousin’s visit. He starts to tell Tom what his cousin had said.

“Tom, my cousin from Brazil visited me last winter. He said he had never seen snow before.” says Walt. “Really? What did he say when it started to fall in Cardiff?” says Tom. “He told me he had always dreamed of it, but he hadn’t expected it to be so cold.” says Walt.
